categories.main_business_segments: Kakaku.com, Inc. operates four main business segments: (1) Kakaku.com, a comprehensive price comparison and purchasing support site including insurance agency services; (2) Tabelog, a restaurant search and reservation platform; (3) JobBox, a job search aggregation service; and (4) Incubation, which includes real estate, travel, transportation, lifestyle, and entertainment media services through various subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages large-scale web platforms, advanced data aggregation, and search technologies to provide comparison, review, and reservation services. Automated systems for transaction processing, scalable cloud infrastructure, and robust information security frameworks underpin its operations. Continuous investment in software development, system reliability, and user experience optimization are central to its production methods.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Kakaku.com primarily serves general consumers seeking product, service, and restaurant information, as well as businesses such as retailers, manufacturers, restaurants, insurance companies, and job advertisers who use its platforms for customer acquisition and promotion. Its end markets span consumer electronics, home goods, financial services, dining, employment, real estate, travel, and entertainment.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are predominantly in Japan, with the vast majority of revenue and assets located domestically. Some services, such as travel and certain media, have limited international reach, but the core business focus remains on the Japanese market.
categories.supply_chain_position: Kakaku.com operates downstream in the digital value chain, acting as an intermediary between consumers and service/product providers. It aggregates and distributes information, facilitates transactions, and provides marketing and reservation solutions, but does not manufacture physical goods.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening core platforms, expanding high-value-added services, and developing new business pillars beyond the main brands. The company emphasizes user-centric innovation, digital transformation (DX) for clients, and investment in AI, security, and system reliability. R&D efforts are modest in scale and focus on applied technology for service enhancement and operational efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through performance-based and listing fees from merchants, service providers, and advertisers (e.g., pay-per-click, pay-per-reservation, pay-per-lead), as well as advertising sales and user subscription fees for premium content. Additional income comes from insurance agency commissions and various transaction-based fees.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Kakaku.com holds leading positions in Japan’s price comparison, restaurant review/reservation, and job aggregation markets. Key competitors include other digital media, e-commerce, and vertical search platforms (e.g., Recruit Holdings, Yahoo! Japan, Gurunavi, Indeed). The company is recognized for its scale, brand strength, and comprehensive service offerings, but faces ongoing competition from both established and emerging digital players.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ended March 2025, consolidated revenue was 78.4 billion yen (up 17.2% YoY), with operating profit of 29.3 billion yen (up 13.5% YoY) and net profit attributable to owners of 20.0 billion yen (up 10.7% YoY). The company has maintained double-digit annual growth in both revenue and profit, with high profitability (operating margin over 35%) and strong cash flow. Total assets reached 93.5 billion yen, and the company employs approximately 1,381 people.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Kakaku.com emphasizes a 'user-first' philosophy, providing highly reliable, comprehensive, and transparent information to support consumer decision-making. Its platforms are differentiated by scale, depth of content, trusted user reviews, and seamless integration of search, comparison, and reservation functions. The company positions itself as a creator of new standards in digital consumer services, focusing on convenience, trust, and innovation.
